buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used during loading and equilibration

salt_name.description: Name or identity of the salt used in the buffer

process_identifier.description: Process ID recorded in eLabFTW (may duplicate workflow process ID)

num_replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per condition

resin_mass_mg.description: Mass of resin used per well

ligand_name.description: Name or identifier of the ligand

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used in the experiment (order matters, used for plate layout)

ligand_concentrations.description: List of ligand concentrations used in the experiment (order matters, used for plate layout)

measurement_wavelength_nm.description: Measurement wavelength of the plate reader

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of ligand calibration curve (Abs vs concentration)

salt_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the salt solution

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit for ligand concentrations (e.g. µM, mM)

ligand_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the ligand solution

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of ligand calibration curve (Abs vs concentration)

num_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations in the plate layout

num_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations in the plate layout

analysis_status.description: Status of the analysis script run

timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were committed to the database

summary.description: Key metrics from Langmuir fits across salt concentrations

num_replicates.description: Number of replicates per condition (from metadata if available)

num_wells_mapped.description: Total number of wells mapped to experimental conditions or files processed

num_warnings.description: Number of warnings produced during analysis

langmuir_fits.description: Langmuir fit parameters per salt concentration, reconstructed from fit CSV if available

r2.description: Coefficient of determination for the fit

num_points.description: Number of data points used for the fit

data_files.description: Output data file paths from analysis script

analysis_results_json.description: Path to main analysis results JSON

raw_tecan_file.description: Path to downloaded or copied raw Tecan Excel file

isotherms_png.description: PNG of loading isotherms with Langmuir fits

isotherms_pdf.description: PDF of loading isotherms with Langmuir fits

raw_analysis.description: Full raw JSON output of the analysis script for traceability
